overall.verdict: The desktop-light variant demonstrates strong visual hierarchy and excellent visceral value implementation with the one-scale bar principle. However, several screens suffer from low emphasis text that reduces data legibility and trust cues. The design maintains good consistency across screens but needs improvements in typography sizing and color emphasis for financial information.
priority_fixes: Increase font size and use appropriate colors for all financial amounts and limits
Improve visibility of trust and verification elements across all screens
Standardize button styling and increase contrast for interactive elements
Enhance data legibility by using appropriate typographic hierarchy for all text elements
Refine layout spacing to create more breathing room and visual organization
